messages:
Maya: DataQuarry pilot update — they want a stability-first onboarding: short lock window (30 days) but with strict non-regression guarantees and a shadow-canary for a week. Need playbook and SOW language.
Eli: Shadow-canary is good for embeddings/search. Propose: mirror 10% of traffic to new model (no user impact) for 7 days, monitor embed-drift and rerank precision.
Ravi: Bench plan: "stability-smoke" suite, 3k probes (1.5k customer, 1.5k canonical). Metrics: embed_cosine_drop_pct, rerank_p@10, token_cost_delta, p95_latency. Pass if embed drop <= 0.8% and p@10 not worse than baseline by >0.005.
Hannah: Canary rollback rules: if embed_cosine_drop_pct > 0.8 OR p95 latency delta > 150ms OR error-rate delta > 0.4% -> immediate pause + auto-rollforward to previous model for live traffic.
Maya: Commercial asks: DataQuarry wants a small onboarding credit + SLA credit if latency p95 goes above agreed target during the 30d lock. Also request audit trail for any rollback actions.
Eli: Operationally, suggest a "stability-guard" matrix:
```
phases:
  - shadow: 10% mirror, 7d, passive
  - soft-canary: 5% live, 24h
  - ramp: 25% -> 50% over 48h
gates:
  - embed_drop_pct <= 0.8
  - p95_latency_delta <= 150ms
  - error_rate_delta <= 0.4%
```
Maya: Who signs off on the bench and gate results? Product approves prompts and acceptance criteria; Eng-ML runs and certifies results; Eng-Platform owns the automation and rollback hooks. Legal drafts SOW clause for lock and SLA credits.
Ravi: If bench fails, allow up to 1 remediation iteration with guidance (14 days). For iterative failures, propose mediation clause: either extend pilot with remediation scope or customer can revert to prior model and we bill normal rates minus onboarding credit.
eng-platform-bot: INFO: Canary template "stability-guard-v1" exists. Audit logging for rollbacks will attach runbook id.
Legal Bot: REMINDER: Include exact definitions for "shadow-canary", failure thresholds, SLA credit mechanics, audit log retention period, and emergency-patch carve-outs. Also include export-control and data-residency confirmations.
Maya: Next steps: 1) Eng-ML builds bench runner and seeds prompts (EOD Wed). 2) Eng-Platform to provision shadow route and confirm logging (Thu). 3) Legal drafts clause (3 business days). 4) Product to finalize SOW and onboarding-credit numbers. I'll post bench output here. :white_check_mark:
Hannah: One more ops note: persist seed sets immutable for the trial and snapshot model binaries used, in case of post-facto disputes.
Maya: Agreed. Added to SOW checklist. Thanks all.
